({{langx|he|הפועל פתח תקווה}}) is an Israeli professional [[association football|football]] club based in the city of [[Petah Tikva]], currently playing in [[Israeli Premier League]]. Its most successful period was throughout the 1950s and 1960s, in which the club won six [[Israeli Premier League|League Championships]] and one [[Israel State Cup|State Cups]]. The club holds to this day the record for most consecutive championships – five – and was ranked in the top three of the league for 14 years between 1954 and 1968. Hapoel Petah Tikva has not won the championship since 1963, and its last titles were the State Cup in 1992 and the [[Toto Cup]] in 2005."}}
